facts.text: I spend my days with old books, so a hot dinner is a real treat. Please pass the bread, carefully.
facts.why: Evie never says this. Her real defining line is 'I... am a librarian!', said to Rick O'Connell after 'I am proud of what I am.'

facts.text: The riverboat up the Nile before it burns
facts.why: The Mummy fandom wiki says the Medjai attack the riverboat and do so much damage that everyone has to jump ship and swim ashore; it does not say the boat burns.
facts.fix: The riverboat up the Nile before the Medjai attack

vibe.verdict: A solid dig camp with Egyptian food and good winks (library shelves, scarabs, Medjai), but the tone stays safe and the plagues are ignored.
missing: I... am a librarian! (Evie to Rick)
Rick in the Cairo prison, 'looking for a good time'
The plagues of Egypt in Cairo (locusts, frogs, flies)
Beni serving Imhotep as a translator
Ardeth Bay's warning: 'He will never eat, he will never sleep, and he will never stop'
ideas: Swap 'Cairo bazaar falafel' for 'Plague platter' with locust-shaped crisps, a nod to Bey's 'Give me frogs! Flies, locusts!'
Swap 'Book of the Dead walnut honey pastries' note for the 'I... am a librarian' pun, 'Overdue, no fine'
Swap 'Cold Egyptian Stella lager' note for Rick's 'I only gamble with my life, never my money'
Add Ardeth's line 'never eat, never sleep, never stop' as the footer, a gag for a food menu
iconic: Scarab beetles under the skin (wink, dish)
The Book of the Dead (wink, dish)
Ardeth Bay's warning that he will never eat (wink)
